offtopic.redirect: I can only help with financing requests, not other topics. {reprompt}
offtopic.welcome: Welcome to WEZA. I can only help with financing requests, not other topics. {reprompt}
offtopic.pause: I can only help with financing requests, so I'll pause here. Message me any time you want to talk about financing.
prompt.greet: Tell me what you would like financing for, for example: I need UGX 30 million to expand my pharmacy.
prompt.amount: How much financing do you need?
prompt.purpose: What will you use the money for?
prompt.customer_type: Which best describes you: a business owner, a salaried employee or a farmer?
prompt.change: Tell me what to change, for example: the amount is 25 million.
id.request: To save you typing, please send a clear photo of the front of your National ID here. I'll read your name and NIN from it and you confirm them. It is shared only with an institution you choose.
id.unreadable_final: I still couldn't read it, so let's type your details instead.
id.unreadable_retry: I couldn't read that clearly. Please send another photo of the front of your National ID: flat, in good light, with all four corners showing.
id.send_or_type: Please send a photo of your National ID here, or tap 'Type my details instead'.
id.saved: Thank you, your details are saved.
id.expired: Note: this National ID expired on {date}. You can continue, but an institution may ask for a current one.
id.tap_confirm: Please tap 'Yes, correct' if the details are right, or 'Send another photo'.
docs.request: Please send a photo or PDF of your {wanted} here. Institutions ask for both, and I'll fill in your business details from them.
docs.next: Thanks, that's saved. Now please send your {document}, or tap 'I don't have it'.
docs.reminder: Please send the document here as a photo or PDF, or tap 'I don't have them'.
docs.licence_expired: Note: this trading licence expired on {date}. Institutions may ask for a current one.
payout.ask: Which mobile number should receive the money if {institution} approves your request? It must be registered with your National ID. Tap below, or type another number.
payout.change_prompt: OK, which number should receive the money?
payout.invalid: That doesn't look like a valid Ugandan mobile number. Please try again, e.g. {example}.
payout.verified: Thank you, your number is verified.
payout.verified_bureau: Thank you. Your number is verified and your National ID details match the credit bureau record. {institution} will see a summary of your credit history.
payout.verified_bureau_pending: Thank you, your number is verified. The credit bureau check couldn't be completed right now; your request continues and {institution} will do its own checks.
payout.sent_crb: I've sent a 10-digit code {how}. Type it here. Entering it confirms this number is yours and authorises the credit bureau check for {institution}.
payout.sent: I've sent a 6-digit code {how}. Type it here to confirm this number is yours.
payout.wait: Please wait a moment, then use the code we already sent.
